chapterInfo.content:
16
Yosef ne Efraim asase no ahyeɛ
1Na deɛ ntonto no yi maa Yosef mma no firi Yeriko Yordan ano, Yeriko asuo apueeɛ, ɛserɛ a ɛfiri Yeriko kɔ Betel bepɔ soɔ no; 2na ɛfiri Betel de kɔ Lus, na ɛtwam kɔ Arkifoɔ hyeɛ so wɔ Atarot, 3na ɛsiane kɔ atɔeɛ, Yafletifoɔ hyeɛ ho de kɔsi anafoɔ Bet-horon hyeɛ so, na ɛde kɔ Geser, na ɛkɔpem mpoano.
4Na Yosef mma Manase ne Efraim nyaa wɔn agyapadeɛ.
5Na Efraimfoɔ no hyeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ nie: Wɔn agyapadeɛ hyeɛ ne Atarot-adar apueeɛ de kɔsi atifi wɔ Bet-horon; 6na ɛhyeɛ no firi hɔ kɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Mikmetat, atifi fam, na ɛkonton kɔ apueeɛ wɔ Taanat-silo, na ɛsiane ho kɔ Yanoa apueeɛ, 7na ɛfiri Yanoa siane kɔ Atarot ne Naarat, na ɛka Yeriko, na ɛkɔpem Yordan ano. 8Ɛhyeɛ no firi Tapua kɔ atɔeɛ kɔsi Kana subonhwa mu, na ɛkɔpem mpoano. Yei ne Efraimfoɔ abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ; 9#Yos 17.9 ne nkuro a wɔyiyi maa Efraimfoɔ wɔ Manasefoɔ agyapadeɛ mu no, nkuro no nyinaa ne ɛho nkuraa. 10#1 Ah 9.16 Nanso wɔantu Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Geser no, na Kanaanfoɔ no atena Efraim mu de abɛduru nnɛ, na wɔayɛ nkoa a wɔde ɔsom adwuma yi toɔ.

Na Yosef mma Manase ne Efraim nyaa wɔn agyapadeɛ.
Na Efraimfoɔ no hyeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ nie: Wɔn agyapadeɛ hyeɛ ne Atarot-adar apueeɛ de kɔsi atifi wɔ Bet-horon; na ɛhyeɛ no firi hɔ kɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Mikmetat, atifi fam, na ɛkonton kɔ apueeɛ wɔ Taanat-silo, na ɛsiane ho kɔ Yanoa apueeɛ, na ɛfiri Yanoa siane kɔ Atarot ne Naarat, na ɛka Yeriko, na ɛkɔpem Yordan ano. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
